topic: How to encourage without nagging: the deal that works
caption:
The secret to motivating your teen without nagging? Make it their idea.

Try the match deal: 'Earn $20 this week and I'll match it.' One clear goal, real money, zero pressure.

It works because they feel in control, not managed.

HustleUp gives them the exact steps to make that $20 happen. See how it works → hustleup.us
